provenance.method: Bounded review of the current NHS eating-disorders overview including its ARFID section; no diagnosis is inferred from eating patterns.

name: NHS eating disorders and ARFID overview
description: NHS overview of eating disorders including avoidant/restrictive food intake disorder (ARFID), symptoms, help routes and the distinction between ARFID and weight/shape-driven restriction.
intended_use: Clinical starting point when food restriction, eating distress or possible eating-disorder symptoms need assessment rather than another productivity strategy.
audience_or_context: People seeking NHS information about eating disorders and ARFID; individual diagnosis and treatment require appropriate clinical assessment.
limitations: Reading an ARFID description cannot establish whether someone has ARFID or another condition.
Eating restriction can have medical, sensory, psychological, gastrointestinal, dental or other causes that need individual assessment.
cost_or_access_notes: Public NHS information; local assessment and treatment routes vary.
